action_items.description: Add a circuit breaker that caps retry volume when queue depth rises
Retune the queue-depth alert threshold to current payout volume
Publish a creator-facing status update template for payout delays

impact: Northlight Studios (sample data — fictional): payouts for 1,200 creators were delayed by up to 6 hours. No payouts were lost or duplicated, and no creator data was affected. Support received 34 contacts about missing payouts during the window.
root_cause: A partial outage in the payout queue caused workers to retry failed jobs aggressively. The retry storm saturated the queue, so new payout jobs waited behind retries for hours. There was no circuit breaker on retry volume, and the queue-depth alert fired 40 minutes after the backlog began because its threshold was set for the old, smaller payout volume.

timeline.action: Confirmed the payout queue backlog and declared Sev-2.
Identified retry storm from workers hitting the partial queue outage.
Paused retries and drained the queue manually.
Queue drained; payouts processing normally again.
Verified all delayed payouts completed; incident resolved.

title: Creator payouts delayed by 6 hours
